scope: synthetic data only; shared natural-language tasks, not provider answer scripts

initialWorkspace.range.mjs: export function inRange(value, min, max) { return value > min && value < max; }

canary.prompt: 接入探測：請使用 read 讀取 note.txt，收到工具結果後用一句話回報其實際內容。這是一次兩回合工具往返，不得修改檔案。
acceptance: second request contains matching tool result

T1.prompt: 請先讀取 note.txt，將 hello 改為 hello calcifer，保留換行。只能修改 note.txt；最後根據工具結果回報。
acceptance: note.txt exactly hello calcifer plus newline

T2.prompt: range.mjs 的 inRange 應包含 min 與 max 邊界。請先讀檔及執行現有五項檢查，定位失敗後做最小修正，再明確執行同一組檢查。不可修改其他檔案；edit 不會替你執行測試。
acceptance: initial tests fail at min and max
same five tests pass after edit
test is a separate tool call

T3.prompt: 只為 operation-fixed 記錄一次合成 append。若工具結果未知，停止並要求核對收據，不能再次 record。核對完成前不得派送下一次推論；收到已核對的收據後只回報實際結果。
acceptance: unknown local side effect blocks model egress
operator readback and reconciliation precede continuation
T3.boundary: Local tool UNKNOWN is separate from a model POST UNKNOWN; reconciling a tool cannot clear a model intent.

tools.edit: one exact replacement in note.txt or range.mjs; never runs tests
tools.record: operation-fixed append with deliberate synthetic lost acknowledgement
tools.receipt: read-only receipt state; no implicit reconciliation
